description:
## What

Delete `Coder.Loop.State.path`. After opi-y0a.2 / opi-y0a.3 / opi-y0a.4, the Agent's `loop.messages` is the canonical working chain; `:path` is duplicate state.

Replacements at the call sites:

- `build_session_context` (sole prod caller was `messages_provider` in init, now gone) — delete the public `Coder.build_session_context`. Internal SessionStore version stays.
- Compaction prep input — already uses `state.path` today; switch to `SessionStore.path(state.store_pid, :leaf, to: :latest_compaction)` on demand inside `do_compact`.
- `do_get_context_usage` / `do_get_session_stats` — currently use `state.path` to compute `SessionManager.build_context_from_path(...)`; switch to `SessionStore.build_session_context(state.store_pid)`.
- Any remaining `state.path` reads — same treatment.

Also drop:

- `Coder.Loop.State.cwd` — already in SessionStore (`SessionStore.get_cwd/1`).
- `:cwd` field if no remaining read sites depend on it being on the loop.

## Why

`:path` was the working linearization Coder.Loop owned. Now that Agent owns the working chain and SessionStore can produce a linearization on demand, keeping a third copy in Coder is just an invariant to maintain.

This *completes* the opi-qy9 trajectory:
- opi-qy9: tree out of Loop, into Store; Loop carries `:path`.
- opi-y0a.5: `:path` out of Loop too. Loop carries almost nothing.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — delete `:path` and `:cwd` from State; rewire the few read sites.
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder.ex` — delete `Coder.build_session_context/1`.

## Out of scope

- `SessionStore.path/3` and `SessionStore.build_session_context/1,2` — already exist, unchanged.

## Done when

- `Coder.Loop.State` has no `:path` or `:cwd` field.
- `Coder.build_session_context/1` removed (or made internal-only if any remaining caller surfaces).
- All existing tests pass.
- A grep for `state.path` in `coder/loop.ex` returns nothing.
title: Drop Coder.Loop's :path cache
